_comment: Tier-2: HARDENING_CURVE is NOT range-checked by the law Check() — values 7 and 8, outside the documented 0..6 enum, pass without any complaint. Pitfall (kratos.constitutive_laws #6). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The core claim holds: curves 7 and 8 produce NO error on SmallStrainIsotropicPlasticity3DVonMisesVonMises. FALSIFIED DETAIL: the claim says 'curves 0, 1, 3, 5, 6 pass with only YIELD_STRESS_TENSION / YIELD_STRESS_COMPRESSION / FRACTURE_ENERGY set' and names only two curves needing extras. THREE do. Curve 6 (CurveDefinedByPoints) raises 'Error: EQUIVALENT_STRESS_VECTOR_PLASTICITY_POINT_CURVE is required when using HARDENING_CURVE = CurveDefinedByPoints.' alongside curve 2 (MAXIMUM_STRESS) and curve 4 (CURVE_FITTING_PARAMETERS). Only 0, 1, 3 and 5 pass bare. The fixture pins the corrected set. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the mutation changes the material deck handed to the law, never the probe. (1) The extra properties curves 2, 4 and 6 demand are SUPPLIED (MAXIMUM_STRESS/MAXIMUM_STRESS_POSITION, CURVE_FITTING_PARAMETERS / TANGENCY_REGION2 / PLASTIC_STRAIN_INDICATORS, and the two PLASTICITY_POINT_CURVE vectors), so all three now report curve[N]_check=PASSED. (2) The out-of-range runs additionally set POISSON_RATIO = 0.6, a bound the SAME Check() call really does enforce ('Error: POISSON_RATIO is above the upper bound 0.5.'), so both come back FAILED. These expect_in_output strings disappear: curve[2]_demands=MAXIMUM_STRESS, curve[4]_demands=CURVE_FITTING_PARAMETERS, curve[6]_demands=EQUIVALENT_STRESS_VECTOR_PLASTICITY_POINT_CURVE, out_of_range_curve[7]_check=PASSED, out_of_range_curve[8]_check=PASSED, hardening_curve_range_mismatches=0 (the mutant prints 5) — and the forbidden token FAIL: is tripped. Part (2) is the load-bearing half: it proves PASSED is a verdict read back from Kratos's own Check() on this build, not a string this fixture always prints. Proof environment: KRATOS_PYTHON=/mnt/kratos-tier2/kv/bin/python (28 applications; the repo-venv Kratos wheel does not load on this glibc and /usr/bin/python3 cannot import this repo). Proved KILLED 2026-08-07.

_mutation.note: The mutation changes the material deck handed to the law, never the probe.
